attribution: David Nash / Astronexus HYG database; Hipparcos, Yale Bright Star and Gliese input catalogs.
selection: 80 records with Gliese identifiers, 80 additional Yale/HR records, 80 additional Hipparcos records. Membership is not independent measurement provenance; catalogs overlap.
